name: join-key-composite-filter
description: Exercise composite equality keys on stored fact rows

queries.name: composite-join-ascending
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, f.amount FROM events e JOIN events f ON e.event_id = f.event_id AND e.user_id = f.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 25

queries.name: composite-join-descending
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, f.category FROM events e JOIN events f ON e.event_id = f.event_id AND e.user_id = f.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id DESC LIMIT 25

queries.name: three-key-join
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, f.quantity FROM events e JOIN events f ON e.event_id = f.event_id AND e.user_id = f.user_id AND e.quantity = f.quantity ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 25
